rules.latestOwnerCameraCorrection: W02 automatically pulls back after the cute close reveal into three-quarter isometric overhead. Start with ONE robot and ready-to-use buildings. No filler bots. Additional matching robots require actual connected sessions or assignments. T01/R01 remain overhead.
rules.designAnchor: The tuned antenna-and-rockets robot defines the surrounding design language at one consistent worker scale. Pearl/slate/copper/cyan materials and helpful, industrious, slightly fragile personality. Close-ups come from the camera. No giant mascot or decorative workers.

acceptanceChecks.name: Actual progress at any arrival time
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Use actual run.checkPlan/steps/checks and kind: source5, legacy smoke6, browser declared plan, unknown project total stays unknown. Counts/result text update even during travel; candidate enrichment cannot reset the performance.

acceptanceChecks.name: Exact scope
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Wrong project/run/attempt/source/candidate cannot drive the selected host or preview; switching project binds its independent state and draft.

acceptanceChecks.name: Historical and unavailable state
acceptanceChecks.criterion: First-bind terminal history, duplicate polls, stale/unknown data and refresh failure do not celebrate or invent working; text identifies saved/unconfirmed state.

acceptanceChecks.name: One actual terminal cue
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Only a newly observed matching terminal transition can cue once; pass is restrained relief, failure concern, cancelled/interrupted/timed_out/stopping/termination_unknown never pass.

acceptanceChecks.name: Explicit management
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Only Your district/map presentation choice enters P01. End of opening, Enter, pass and provider events do not force overhead or dispatch an assignment.

acceptanceChecks.name: Draft and commit
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Typing/focus/partial speech keep presentation moving and dispatch nothing; Enter or explicit completed dictation commits once; failure keeps the draft; reduced motion remains usable.

acceptanceChecks.name: Kinds of evidence
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Legacy six smoke steps, five project recipe checks and separate browser checks retain their actual names/counts/source identity. Source pass is not browser pass or owner art acceptance.

acceptanceChecks.name: Provider failure truth
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Installed CLI is not authenticated or quota-ready. Explicit model/effort is retained or rejected; provider/auth/limit/exit failure preserves work and cannot qualify a prose-only edit.

acceptanceChecks.name: Exact candidate preview
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Preview/window/browser check uses current project/run/candidate hash plus nonce/display/region where applicable; source change or tampering rejects freshness. Prior result remains historical.

acceptanceChecks.name: Multiple projects and attention
acceptanceChecks.criterion: All seven projects retain latest and active/unresolved run identity under noisy history, plus independent drafts/regions/top-side and overview-split views. Runtime pins each project's latest and all nonterminal/termination_unknown runs before adding recent100; attention/selection never dispatches.

acceptanceChecks.name: Lifecycle and access
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Hidden panes stop/dispose their GPU resources; resize/context loss/reduced motion/fallback preserve controls and truthful text. Root owns 4K native qualification.

acceptanceChecks.name: Cancellation and recovery
acceptanceChecks.criterion: Cancellation shows stopping until owned-process termination evidence; unknown termination stays unknown. Checkpoint restore archives current owned bytes and requires new checks/preview.
